vehicles.slot: Cap at side of console shifter base
shift: Turn ignition to ON.
Locate the shift lock slot — Cap at side of console shifter base.
Insert a thin key or flathead into the slot.
Press firmly and hold.
Press the brake pedal.
Move the TorqueFlite selector to Neutral.
neutral: Apply parking brake.
Connect jump pack to battery — Under hood, driver side.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to N normally.
vehicles.notes: 4WD: transfer case MUST be in 2H before towing on road.
vehicles.towMethod: RWD/2WD: lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air. 4WD: transfer case to 2H first, then lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.

tc.type: Electric push-button (NV244/NV246 Autotrac) or manual lever depending on trim
positions: 2WD (2H) — rear wheels only — REQUIRED for all road towing
4WD Auto — automatic AWD — NOT safe for towing
4WD Hi (4H) — part-time 4WD — NOT safe for dry-road towing
N — neutral (some models)
4WD Lo (4L) — low range — NEVER tow in this position
steps: Slow to under 3 MPH.
ELECTRIC: Press the 2WD button on the dash. Wait for 2WD indicator.
MANUAL: Stop completely. Shift TC lever to 2H.
Confirm 2WD indicator is illuminated before lifting rear wheels.
NEVER tow in 4H, 4WD Auto, or 4L.
IF BATTERY IS DEAD: Jump battery first to power electronic TC, shift to 2WD, then disconnect. If unable to shift, FLATBED ONLY.

towNotes: MANUAL TRANSFER CASE (floor lever): Vehicle must be STOPPED to shift. If lever is stiff, rock vehicle slightly in neutral while applying firm pressure.
ELECTRONIC TRANSFER CASE: Requires 12V power to shift. If battery is dead, jump the battery FIRST, then shift TC to 2WD before disconnecting.
DEAD BATTERY FALLBACK: If TC cannot be shifted to 2WD, USE FLATBED. Do NOT tow with TC in 4WD/4H/4L — will destroy transfer case and driveline.
4WD DOLLY FALLBACK: If transfer case CANNOT be shifted to 2WD (dead battery, mechanical failure), either use flatbed OR wheel-lift with dollies on the opposite axle.

vehicles.slot: Electronic selector — trim panel near selector, remove to expose slot
shift: Turn ignition to ON.
Locate the electronic selector override: Electronic selector — trim panel near selector, remove to expose slot.
Remove trim panel or cover if present — use a trim pry tool or your fingernail at the edge.
Insert a thin key or flathead into the exposed slot.
Press firmly inward and hold.
While holding, press the brake pedal.
Press the N button or move the electronic selector to Neutral.
neutral: Apply parking brake.
Connect jump pack to battery — Under hood.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and select N normally on the electronic selector.
Electronic selectors require power — mechanical override is a last resort only.
vehicles.notes: eTorque mild hybrid: same 12V procedure. eTorque mild hybrid (2019+): 12V auxiliary under hood. Same jump procedure as standard.

knownIssues.title: eTorque Mild Hybrid — Not Full Hybrid
knownIssues.detail: The eTorque system is a 48V mild hybrid assist. Despite having a small lithium battery, this is NOT a full hybrid. The 12V battery under the hood is used for jumping normally. The eTorque battery is not accessible for jumping and is managed separately by the vehicle.

battery.warnings: eTorque 48V system is separate — 12V under hood for jumping only.

knownIssues.title: Manual Transfer Case Lever May Be Stiff
knownIssues.detail: The NV271 manual transfer case floor lever on older HD Rams can be extremely stiff, especially if the vehicle has been in 4WD for extended periods. Rock the vehicle gently in neutral while applying firm pressure to the lever. Do not force — damage to the TC shift fork can occur.

knownIssues.title: Very Heavy Vehicle — Equipment Ratings Critical
knownIssues.detail: Ram 2500/3500 curb weight ranges from 6,400–7,200 lbs. A fully loaded 3500 dually can exceed 14,000 lbs GVWR. Verify all wheel-lift and flatbed equipment is rated appropriately. Standard equipment is often under-rated for these trucks.

battery.location: Under hood. Cummins diesel may have dual batteries on driver side.
battery.jumpTerminals: Under hood: red (+) on either battery (diesel), black (−) to engine block
battery.warnings: Diesel dual batteries. Very heavy. Verify equipment ratings. Manual TC lever may be stiff on older models.

vehicles.slot: ZF 9HP ROTARY dial located to the LEFT of the steering column — small override slot near dial base.
shift: Turn ignition to ON.
ZF 9HP rotary selector: RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST — strongly recommended.
Connect jump pack — under hood.
Once powered, press brake and rotate dial to N.
WITHOUT POWER: override slot near BASE of rotary dial.
Insert thin flathead. Apply FIRM sustained pressure for 5-10 seconds.
While holding, press brake and rotate to N.
Rotary selector on LEFT side of steering column (not center console).
neutral: Apply parking brake.
Connect jump pack to battery — Under hood.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and move column shifter to N normally.
vehicles.notes: Commercial van. Based on Fiat Ducato platform. ProMaster City uses ZF 9HP rotary selector — restore 12V power before shifting. ZF 9HP requires more force than standard if shifted without power.
vehicles.towMethod: Lift from front — front (drive) wheels in the air, or flatbed. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
towNotes: FWD: lift from front (front/drive wheels in the air) freely. If rear-lift is not possible, place wheel dollies under the REAR wheels and tow front-first.
HEAVY VEHICLE: Use properly rated wheel blocks, straps, and chains. Verify your equipment weight rating before attempting to load or lift.

knownIssues.title: ZF 9HP Rotary Requires 12V Power
knownIssues.detail: The ProMaster City uses a ZF 9HP rotary dial selector. This transmission requires 12V power to shift reliably. Always jump the battery first.

knownIssues.title: ZF 9HP Rotary Selector — Left of Steering Column
knownIssues.detail: The ProMaster City's rotary gear selector is NOT on the center console — it is to the LEFT of the steering column. The ZF 9HP requires 12V power for reliable shifting. Mechanical override requires significant force.

battery.warnings: AGM battery. ZF 9HP rotary: must restore power before shifting for reliable operation.
